papers.title: Solid-state transformations and the residual stress–texture relationship in fiber laser-welded Ti-6Al-4V
papers.first_author_affiliation: Department of Aerospace Engineering, King Fahd University of Petroleum and Minerals (KFUPM), Saudi Arabia

corresponding_authors.name: Tabassam Yasmeen
corresponding_authors.affiliation: Department of Aerospace Engineering, King Fahd University of Petroleum and Minerals (KFUPM), Saudi Arabia

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文涉及光纤激光焊接Ti-6Al-4V，而非增材制造工艺，与方向无关。
llm.why_not_core: This paper studies fiber laser welding, not additive manufacturing (LPBF/SLM/EBM/DED), so it does not fall within the scope of AM Ti-6Al-4V mechanical/fatigue performance.

summary_zh.motivation: 研究激光焊接Ti-6Al-4V的固态转变与残余应力-织构关系。
summary_zh.method: 使用光纤激光焊接并进行微观结构表征。
summary_zh.result: 揭示了固态转变对残余应力和织构的影响。
summary_zh.validation: 无实验验证或仅材料表征。

summary_en.motivation: The study aims to understand the relationship between solid-state transformations and residual stress-texture in fiber laser-welded Ti-6Al-4V.
summary_en.method: Fiber laser welding experiments were conducted followed by microstructural characterization.
summary_en.result: The influence of solid-state transformations on residual stress and texture was elucidated.
summary_en.validation: No experimental validation beyond material characterization.
